metadata.title: Triviality of $K$-homology classes of Euler characteristic operators of stratified pseudomanifolds
metadata.abstract: We show that the $K$-homology classes of the Euler characteristic operators associated with the minimal and maximal ideal boundary conditions of the de Rham differential on the regular part of a connected compact Thom-Mather stratified pseudomanifold, equipped with an adapted metric, are trivial beyond their indices. These indices are the Euler characteristics of the corresponding $L^2$-cohomologies. This generalizes a result of J. Rosenberg for manifolds. The proof uses Witten deformation of the de Rham operator associated with a stratified Morse function, following the work of Álvarez López and Calaza.

analysis.progressType: 分层空间的 K-同调约化
analysis.workSummary: 对带适配度量的紧连通 Thom–Mather 分层伪流形，证明 de Rham 微分最小和最大理想边界条件对应的 Euler 算子 K-同调类除指标外无额外信息。
techniques: L² 上同调与 K-同调
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Rosenberg 的流形结论推广到有奇性的分层空间。
analysis.limitations: 并非 Euler 指标本身消失；两种边界条件的指标分别由对应 L² 上同调的 Euler 数给出。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对奇性分析和指标理论有用，但需熟悉算子域与理想边界条件。
